data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Katharina, meaning pure or clean. In the New Testament, St. Catherine of Alexandria is the patron saint of philosophers, scholars, and unmarried women. Parents who choose Kathlin usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clean and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name Kathlin is also linked to Saint Catherine, a revered figure in Christian tradition, known for her wisdom, courage, and faith.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Kathlin" or "Katharine" has significant cultural associations with purity, education, and strength. Her feast day, November 25th, was widely celebrated throughout Europe, and the name became popular among noble and scholarly families.
